title: English everywhere, 70 official kits and a monorepo type
items: first-commit is now fully in English: website, CLI, kits, libraries, emails and docs. Old Spanish URLs redirect to the new ones.
70 official kits, 10 per type, including the new Monorepo type (Turborepo, Nx, Bun, uv, Go workspaces and full-stack pairs).
A design pack (frontend-design, impeccable, web-design-guidelines…) in every kit with an interface.
New docs: introduction, CLI, API and FAQ.

title: first-commit pack, framework skills and more options
items: first-commit pack: a selection of general-purpose skills (plan, debug, verify, review, improve the architecture and find skills) in every kit.
Official framework skills: Next.js, Vue/Nuxt (and Pinia) and Svelte bring their authors' best practices.
Next.js: Neon, Turso and MongoDB databases; Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Paddle and Mercado Pago payments; deployment on Netlify, Render, Railway and Fly.io.
27 new libraries for Astro, SvelteKit, Nuxt, React, Python, Django, Go, Rails, Laravel and Spring.

title: Brand profiles, more languages and workflow skills
items: Brand profiles: a client's colors, fonts, rules and documentation, applied to any kit with --brand.
9 new kits: Astro, SvelteKit, Nuxt, Vite + React, Elysia, Django, Rails, Laravel and Spring Boot.
Superpowers and Matt Pocock's skills (grill-me, improve-codebase-architecture) in every kit.
Per-language pages, agent and language icons, and a bar that keeps the command at hand on every kit.

title: Teams, private kits and paid kits
items: Organizations with a private registry: only their members see and install their kits.
Required and forbidden library policies, checked by `doctor` in CI.
Creators can sell kits (one-time payment) and get paid into their Stripe account.
Weekly newsletter, a changelog with RSS, and pricing, terms and privacy pages.

title: Stacks, comparisons and a badge for your README
items: Stack pages: tested combinations (Next.js + Supabase + Stripe, Expo + NativeWind…) installable in one command.
Comparisons between libraries of the same category with real usage data.
An SVG badge with your kit's installs, ready to paste into your README.

title: Your agent creates the project
items: MCP server: `mcp` locally (search, recommend, plan and create projects) and a read-only remote endpoint.
"Describe your project" on the home page recommends a kit with its options.
A prompt tab on every kit to paste into Claude Code, Cursor or Codex.

title: Full catalog and kits for Python, Go and iOS
items: New categories: auth, database, payments, email, languages, AI, tests, quality, CI and deployment.
api-fastapi, api-go and ios-swiftui kits.
Search kits by library in the ranking.
